tools.name: about_nexwin
tools.description: Explains what Nexwin is and how to sign up. Use when the user asks what Nexwin is, what it does, or how to get started — no account connection needed.

tools.name: get_bookings
tools.description: Lists the connected Nexwin account's appointments/bookings in a date range (max 30 days, first 25 results). Each booking includes its appointmentId and teamMemberId (needed for reschedule_booking and cancel_booking), exact ISO startTime/endTime, and timezone. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: Lists the connected Nexwin account's active team members with their teamMemberId and timezone. Call this before create_booking to get a real teamMemberId and the timezone to book in. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: get_call_chat_history
tools.description: Lists recent calls or chats for the connected Nexwin account in a date range, without full transcripts. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: get_call_chat_detail
tools.description: Fetches the full transcript and detail for one call or chat, by id. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: get_account_usage_summary
tools.description: Plan, subscription status, minutes/messages used this period, and wallet balance for the connected Nexwin account.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a new appointment on the connected Nexwin account and emails the customer a confirmation. Executes immediately. Get teamMemberId and timezone from list_team_members first. Online bookings require customerEmail and create a Zoom meeting; in-person bookings need customerEmail or customerPhone.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Moves an existing booking (appointmentId from get_bookings) to a new time and emails the customer about the change. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_call_chat_history, get_call_chat_detail, get_account_usage_summary, create_booking, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_activity_summary, get_ai_setup, update_ai_setup, invite_team_member, import_customers · Private data: get_account_usage_summary, find_customer, restore_ai_setup_version · Public sink: find_customer, invite_team_member, import_customers · Destructive: update_ai_setup, update_service_area, remove_team_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_call_chat_history, get_call_chat_detail, get_account_usage_summary, create_booking, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_activity_summary, get_ai_setup, update_ai_setup, invite_team_member, import_customers · Private data: get_account_usage_summary, find_customer, restore_ai_setup_version · Public sink: find_customer, invite_team_member, import_customers · Destructive: update_ai_setup, update_service_area, remove_team_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
